paper text.text:
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction} gives the possible
forms on either side. A segment with ends $b,w$ in $B_b$, or $d,w$
in $B_d$, may be an original edge or a path with one interior
vertex. The two choices of nonplanar completion give $156$
candidates~\supp{E15}. Each has a $K_5$ minor, a cut of at most two
vertices, or a proper nontoroidal minor. This excludes the remaining
case.

vertex names: Psi_2: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with neighbourhood {a,b,d}, as in Section 5. Further vertices with these neighbourhoods are p3, ... and r3, .... Interior vertices of bridges are u0, u1, ... Twins p', q' have neighbourhood {a,c,w}, as in Section 5.4.3.

specification.contracted side: zD adjacent to a, d, w
zB adjacent to b, c, w

P nonplanar.meaning: P = G minus the four twins, with no edges among a,b,c,d; Section 5.4 assumes P planar
